title: Rosetta: Precision Embed Quality Harness and Drift Ops
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Background:
We need a repeatable, production-ready evaluation harness that measures embedding accuracy and reranker fidelity across model variants and operating conditions. Existing nightly runs are ad-hoc and focus on signal-level drift; Rosetta centralizes reference corpora, multi-metric scoring, and operational alerts so product teams can trust quality over time.

Goals:
- Create a curated reference corpus ("Rosetta set") covering 12 production verticals and a stratified sample of heavy, medium, and tail queries.
- Implement an offline runner that computes per-model and per-route metrics nightly: recall@1/5/10, MAP@10, average cosine drift, embedding norm stability, interquartile distance, and rerank NDCG@10.
- Surface regression alerts with severity (info/warn/critical) tied to user-visible thresholds and deliverable runbook links.
- Keep compute cost under budget by sampling and adaptive evaluation windows while preserving statistical power for drift detection.

Scope and non-goals:
In scope: corpus curation process, nightly pipeline, metric definitions, alerting integration with PagerDuty/Grafana, dashboards, and a simple UI for inspecting counterexamples.
Out of scope: automatic model rollback; that will be handled by rollout policies in a follow-up ticket.

Design decisions and trade-offs:
- Reference set vs. continuous sampling: we'll maintain a small, human-curated Rosetta reference + larger synthetic perturbation set used for sensitivity probes. The curated set provides low-noise regressions; synthetic probes stress edge cases.
- Metrics: prefer ranking-aware metrics (NDCG, MAP) plus distributional drift stats rather than only mean cosine change. This better correlates with user-facing quality regressions.
- Sampling cadence: nightly full-run on Rosetta set and weekly aggregated checks on production-sampled logs. This balances timeliness with cost.
- Alert thresholds: use dynamic baselines (28-day rolling median) with absolute minimum thresholds to avoid alerting on natural variance.

Data & Golden/reference curation process:
- Pull 20k labeled Q-A pairs from product teams (see linked Confluence doc). Labeling rubric includes relevance tiers and known duplicates.
- Augment with 40k synthetic perturbations (noise, paraphrase, truncation) to probe robustness.
- Store reference vectors and metadata encrypted at rest in the eval datastore (access controlled).

Pipeline and infra:
- Runner implemented as a k8s CronJob in the infra repo; runs on dedicated CPU nodes with optional GPU acceleration for batched rerank scoring.
- Uses Redwood Embed API (hosted) and the internal rerank simulator to compute logits and ranking metrics.
- Outputs JSON artifacts per run: per-route metric bundle and counterexample list. Artifacts uploaded to S3 and indexed in the evaluation catalog.

Telemetry & alerting:
- Instrument per-token timing and per-request end-to-end latency for embeddings and rerank passes.
- Send metrics to Grafana/Loki; alerts wired to Slack channel #embed-quality and PagerDuty for critical regressions.
- Alert logic examples: NDCG@10 drop >5% vs 28d baseline (warn), drop >12% (critical). Cosine drift above historical 99th percentile -> investigate.

Rollout & operational playbook:
- Run harness against candidate model prior to any rollout. If critical regression, block rollout and create evaluation ticket with artifacts.
- On alert, on-call follows runbook: reproduce locally, triage root cause (model change vs data shift), and if model is culprit, coordinate with model-ops for immediate rollback.

Acceptance criteria:
- Nightly run completes within 3 hours and publishes metrics to Grafana and S3.
- Alerts trigger correctly for injected synthetic regressions in canary tests.
- Dashboards show stable baselines for control models and clear signal for introduced perturbations.
- Documentation and runbook published and reviewed by PM and SRE.

Risks and mitigation:
- False positives from natural traffic drift -> mitigate with 28-day dynamic baselines and minimum effect size thresholds.
- Cost overruns from large-scale rerank simulation -> cap full rerank runs to weekends and rely on sampled checks during weekdays.

Next steps (milestones):
- 2025-11-10: Finalize Rosetta set selection and labeling rubric (owner: UX/PM).
- 2025-11-21: Implement nightly runner prototype and basic metrics (owner: Eng).
- 2025-12-01: Integrate alerts + dashboard and run synthetic regression smoke tests (owner: Eng + SRE).
- 2025-12-15: Documentation, runbook sign-off, and handoff to product teams.

Notes on cross-team reviews and dependencies:
- PM review requested: Riley Thompson (product) — please validate vertical coverage and thresholds.
- Security: encryption and access audit to be reviewed by Security (ticket to be created if needed).
- Depends on embedding throughput improvements in ENG-341900 and the evaluation catalog work in ENG-32456.
